author: Rainstruck
body:
Okay, so I really wanted to create another map, however I was super bored of doing it by myself. I love the maps Port town and Quintus, so I decided to kind of mix them together and put my own sort of vibe on it! Harry also wanted to help me create this glorious map! I'm pleased to announce my next map, Pinnacle!! 



Map name: Pinnacle
Creator: RileGuy, JrMapDev
Contributors (optional): SnowSX3, Glesmon, Petlas
Gamemode: DTM
Download link: coming soon
YML: http://pastebin.com/GN7e7uxY
Pictures: http://imgur.com/a/9CvLP

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Please note that this map is still being worked on a lot. So Feedback is very welcome! I know that the planks don't look appealing, and I already have plans to change them. 

-RileGuy

replies.author: Rainstruck
replies.body:
You can't jump from side to side. Its about a 10 block bridge, and one of the ways that it is similar to Port town, is that your monuments are on the farthest side on the adjacent teams bases. Here is a picture to help describe what I am talking about:



The Boxes represent each teams side
The Stars represent the monuments location for each team

So Basically you have to walk right past their spawn to get to your monument. 

PS: I have amazing Microsoft Paint Skills

replies.author: Rainstruck
replies.body:
Alright so there have been a lot of updates in the most recent changes, and I would like to thank Mr. Dawning_ for a lot of the changes that were suggested and applied. So here is a full list of the changes that happened in the v1.1 update:

Additions:
- Added Iron Block Buttons
- Changed some of the pathways distances from the center
- Added Enchantment Table to middle with Bookshelves around it
- Some Designs on the Main Islands
- Some Designs on the Planks

Deletions:
- Removed Some fence posts
- Changed some glasswork

YML Plans:
- Every time you get a kill, you will receive 1 or 2 enchantment bottles
- Iron Block Button
- You will not be able to break any part of the beacon above each of the monuments. this is used so that players will easily be able t tell which monuments they need to go to
-You will not be able to place in the enchantment area, nor the surrounding areas.

I'm sure that some of you are worried about the amount of void space. The idea is that you will use the circles to bridge over to your monuments. Hopefully this will be able to be worked out when this map actually gets played. Also I updated the Album with new pictures of the design. Hope you enjoy it!
